methodology.first_call: After jax.clear_caches(); includes tracing/compilation and execution. Existing persistent disk caches may still be reused.
methodology.warm_latency: Sequential calls; every output leaf blocks before stopping the clock. Warmup calls are excluded from repeat summaries.
methodology.included: Public API validation, dispatch, device execution, synchronization; NumPy input handling/transfers in eager paths.
methodology.excluded: Imports, backend initialization, fixture creation, orbit caching, device-input preparation, output validation and report serialization.
methodology.dynamic_arguments: Observation duration T, epoch t0, parameters, cached positions; BW, backend, response_samples, format and window shape are static.
methodology.batch_order: Contiguous disjoint catalogue slices, cycling across repeats; amortized per-source latency is batch latency divided by batch size.
methodology.scope: Waveform APIs and A/E derivatives; no likelihood, sampler, or C baseline.

workloads.name: native_eager_cached_numpy
workloads.inputs: NumPy float64 native vector; cached JAX positions
workloads.outputs: X, Y, Z, A, E, qmin, freq_bin_indices (raw GLASS units)

workloads.name: physical_eager_cached_gbparams
workloads.inputs: GBParams with Python float fields; cached JAX positions
workloads.outputs: X, Y, Z, A, E, qmin, freq_bin_indices (raw GLASS units)

workloads.name: native_outer_jit_cached
workloads.inputs: device float64 native vector; cached JAX positions
workloads.outputs: X, Y, Z, A, E, qmin, freq_bin_indices (raw GLASS units)

workloads.name: fixed_window_ae_outer_jit_cached
workloads.inputs: device float64 native vector; cached JAX positions
workloads.outputs: A/E, shape (2, BW+64), continuous Fourier units

workloads.name: batch_native_outer_jit_cached
workloads.inputs: device float64 native batch; shared cached JAX positions
workloads.outputs: X, Y, Z, A, E, qmin, freq_bin_indices (raw GLASS units); leading batch axis on every leaf

workloads.name: jacfwd_ae_outer_jit_cached
